newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED ON UNITS AT TUESDAY'S CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED ON UNITS AT TUESDAY'S CLOSE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed softer against the U.S dollar and pound sterling on Tuesday but was quoted firmer against the mark and the rand, dealers said.
"There was an inflow of money into the market and the Zimbabwe dollar appreciated on the back of that, but then later we saw it go down on the back of outflows," one dealer said.
He said the local unit firmed to 11.2800/2900 against the key U.S. dollar before succumbing to import pressure to end the day at 11.2950/3050. This compared with late Monday's 11.2850/2950.
It also finished weaker against the sterling at 18.4900/5100 compared to 18.4500/6500. Against the South African rand it was at 2.5300/5500 from 2.5400/5600.
